notes: Proof Artifact Registry (Contract D). captured:true entries MUST reference non-empty files on disk (scripts/verify-manifest-sync.mjs enforces this) and then render as 'Verified Recording · <captured_version>'. Everything else renders an explicit 'Illustrative Schematic' badge. No entry on this page may imply a verified recording that was never captured.

chapters.title: Keep your CLIs. Add a living brain.
chapters.limitations: Provider coverage depends on the CLIs installed on your PATH; axym doctor lists a missing provider as 'not found'. Prompt-cache reuse figures are schematic until captured.

chapters.title: Run agents in parallel without collisions.
chapters.limitations: Windows native JobObject certification (VL-7) is tracked separately; psmux is supported as an opt-in pane viewer.

chapters.title: Firewall tools, stop hangs, control spend.
chapters.limitations: Cost estimates come from a dated local rate card, not live pricing; shadow evidence is labelled speculative and never scored as proof.

chapters.title: Build, diff, and test mobile apps natively.
chapters.limitations: Simulator journeys are the certified surface. Real-phone Wi-Fi cert-pinning and closed-app Web Push are part of the T-050 hardware journey, which is partial.

chapters.title: Ship only what passes independent proof.
chapters.limitations: Review independence is labelled, not certified; cassette replay proves the recorded run reproduces, not that future runs will.
